descriptions.d26l_key_border_uvs_802c7f60: Looks up FE.K.KeyBdr (0x8015ae3c, cast 0x80343808). If its entry count (0x80171f90) is not already 10, resizes it to 10 (0x80171ee0), obtains the two 80-byte tables (0x80171fa0, 0x80171ff8), clears them, writes the fixed coordinates and then for each of the ten pairs sets the first table's y to 1 minus its y minus the second table's y. Owns its literal pool in .rodata; the name string stays external.
